title: Bosun Yeoman Contact Contract v1
description: Machine-readable schema contract for a Yeoman (Realm 4: Contacts) contact dossier's YAML frontmatter. Authoritative records are CommonMark files at `locker_yeoman/contacts/<uuid>.md`.

schema.description: Frontmatter type tag identifying this entity as a Yeoman contact, schema version 1.

$pkm.description: PKM envelope carrying the schema tag and optional graph relations.

id.description: Stable contact identifier. Matches the contacts/<uuid>.md filename.

emails.description: Email addresses associated with the contact.

channels.description: Structured contact channels. Complements `emails`; additionalProperties remain open on the dossier.

preferred_channel.description: Preferred channel kind or address, as observed in harbormaster contact fixtures.

target.description: Target entity identifier, file path, or URI.

relations.description: Typed directed graph edges from this contact to other entities.
